_comment: FileChanged lives in its own file on purpose. The event was added in Claude Code v2.1.83; how an older build treats an unrecognized event name in a hooks file is undocumented, so isolating it means a worst case of 'disk-watching capture is missing' rather than 'the Stop gate silently stopped existing'. The matcher is deliberately omitted: a FileChanged matcher registers literal filenames in the cwd rather than matching paths, and omitting it fires the hook for every dynamically watched path, which is what session_start.py supplies.
